title: Fun Facts About Me: How to Answer in Interviews, Office Intros and College (25 Examples)
seoTitle: Fun Facts About Me: How to Answer, With Examples
seoDescription: How to answer "tell me a fun fact about yourself" in an interview, team intro or college orientation: a simple formula, 25 examples and what to avoid.
excerpt: A three-part formula for a fun fact that sounds natural, 25 ready examples sorted by type, how to fit the answer to a placement interview or a team intro, and the topics best skipped in Indian interviews and offices.
